description: Earthquakes@GA is a data repository run by Geoscience Australia. The site provides the national earthquake catalogue and recent-earthquake feeds of Australia with location, depth and magnitude, and a search of historical events. Coverage: Australia and its region. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. It can support earthquake hazard studies for Australian infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
